tags.description: Protected white sand, mud beach accessible at all tides. Kelp. Camp on beach at most tides or in ~6 cleared sites in forested upland at E end of beach. Water at seasonal creek in NE. Some commercial use. Trail E to First Nations site.
tags.name: Shelter Bay (BCMT)

tags.description: Sand/mud/rock beach with grass strip usable to ~4.6m tide. Sheltered, undeveloped. Good seasonal creek. Respect IR (reserve) land. Old house at village site.
tags.name: Blunden Harbour (BCMT)

tags.description: Rough shallow beach with boulders. Sheltered except from W. Sheltered, undeveloped. Camp in trees. One good site to N of creek. Others possible with brushing. Little beach at high water. Water at creek. Wreck.
tags.name: Cockatrice Bay (BCMT)

tags.description: Shallow mud beach with boulders. Impractical at lower tide levels. Marginal site. Water at small creek. Undeveloped. Possible site to W of creek or at the head of the bay on solid rock which is dry at nearly all tides.
tags.name: Dobbin Bay (BCMT)

tags.description: Low gradient beach of mud, sand with many small boulders at low water. S aspect. Protected. Camp on high bench in trees behind large boulder on beach. Beach floods at Springs. Water at seasonal creek to W of tent sites. Attractive. Aka Sunday Harbour.
tags.name: Crib Island (BCMT)

tags.description: Moderate gradient cobble beach in sheltered bay, exposed rock shelf at low water. Large area with sheltered tent sites, platforms in forested upland at 3 locations. Attractive, sunny. Views, trails. Day use by commercial groups likely. Creek seasonal.
tags.name: Big Bay Beach Hanson Island (BCMT)

tags.description: Moderate gravel beach, drift logs at high water, canoe run through large cobble at mid water. Mud, sand at low water. Tent pads. Pit toilet. Cookhouse. Food cache. Might be exclusive commercial in future. Water at seasonal creek. Views and viewpoint.
tags.name: Boat Bay (BCMT)

tags.description: Moderately steep beach. Patches of sand, grass but mainly mixed rocks at low, mid water. Signpost visible from water. 5 developed large double sites. 6 picnic tables. Fire rings. Can be damp, buggy. Regrowth of small alders. Water at creek 0.5 NM to E.
tags.name: Cypress Harbour (BCMT)

tags.description: Rough rock beach with boat run for low, mid water levels. Float, dock but not close. Well protected. One tent pad. Clear level grass areas upland. Pit toilet near dock. Picnic tables. Attractive. Year-round creek. Hiking trail to lakes.
tags.name: Greenway Sound (BCMT)

tags.description: Dock with float. NW aspect. Adjacent beach landing to SE near creek gives access on cobble, boulder, bedrock at all water levels. Sign visible from water. Developed site in mature trees. Picnic infra. Creek likely year-round.
tags.name: Moore Bay (BCMT)

tags.description: Moderate gradient cobble, rocks beach. Boulders. Long carry at low water. All-tide beach camping on pebble. Summer Springs to 5.0 m leave small beach area. Upland sites possible with brushing. Year-round creek, waterfall, pool. Attractive. View.
tags.name: Goletas Waterfall (BCMT)

tags.description: Low gradient cobble beach. Spacious, sheltered, grassy area between trees, towards point. Afternoon sun. Rustic camp furniture. Seasonal water at creek, to ~june. Attractive, popular site. Short trail.
tags.name: Nolan Point (BCMT)

tags.description: Protected steep cobble, gravel beach. Spacious, semi-exposed camp on level gravel bar. Some protection from NW. Water at creek. Attractive. Road nearby.
tags.name: Songhees Creek (BCMT)

tags.description: Developed site. Gravel / pebble beach, exposed. Water at tap or water from culvert above the rec site. Road access could be rough. Parking. View. Logging camp nearby but all buildings have been removed from the site. Whale rubbing beach. Boat launch.
tags.name: Naka Creek (BCMT)

tags.description: Cobble beach with some boulders. S aspect. Reef gives some protection from NW. A few upland forest sites with potential for many more. Water at small creek.
tags.name: Simson Reef (BCMT)

tags.description: Informal site secondary. Exposed to NW. Upland forest site 50 m S of creek in front of small cliff had rockfall 2021 At Neaps potential beach camp next to drift logs. View. Water at falls, likely year round.
tags.name: Waterfall Beach (BCMT)

tags.description: Dispersed site primary. Large undeveloped site. Road access in past. Aka Prince of Wales Bay. Large 33 Ha. site.
tags.description:landing: Easy on low gradient, broad, pebble, gravel beach. Exposed to NW. Current hazards, turbulence. Vessel traffic.
tags.name: Camp Point (BCMT)

tags.description: Cobble beach with some boulders, tricky at high tide. Some protection from NW. Forest very dense behind beach but up rocks on E side is small level point with room for 3 or more tents in upland forest. Some brushing needed. Water at small creek. View.
tags.name: Nelson Beach West (BCMT)

tags.description: Informal site primary. White, shallow sand beach. Camp on beach or in forest clearings. JK guide has camp at 50 28.95N 126 01.64W. Some sites are adjacent to logged area further from creek. Water at creek. Aka West Blenkinsop Cove on Cruising Planner map.
tags.name: Little Blenkinsop Bay (BCMT)

tags.description: All-tide landing on beach in narrow protected cove. Rock below, broken shell above. Small tent clearing in upland. Reported to be buggy. Assume adequate space for additional tents if brushed. Hammock opportunities. Year-round water at cove head in creek.
tags.name: Squally Channel (BCMT)

tags.description: Broad white sand beach. Beach sites or upland forest clearings just above beach. Water at creek at N end of beach to S or in next cove. Fine sand, attractive. View. Beach to S has start of rough hiking trail/route to Mt. Pender. Buggy.
tags.name: Campania Island central (BCMT)

tags.description: Broad white sand beach. Low gradient. Beach camping on all but the highest tides. No upland tent sites found 2022. Attractive. Water at creek at N end of beach. Popular, favoured site. Buggy. Rough access to upland hiking.
tags.name: Campania Mount Pender (BCMT)
